excerpts.exact_text: Parent and Merger Sub shall use reasonable best efforts to take, or cause to be taken, all actions and do, or cause to be done, all things necessary, advisable or proper to obtain the proceeds of the Debt Financing contemplated by the Debt Commitment Letter on or prior to the Closing Date
obtaining the Financing is not a condition to the obligations of the parties to consummate the Merger in accordance with the terms and provisions of this Agreement.
taking into consideration the timing of the Closing and the completion of the Marketing Period

alternative financing in an amount, together with the amount of Financing remaining available and cash and cash equivalent on hand at the Company and its Subsidiaries, sufficient to pay the Required Amount on the Closing Date, in each case, upon terms and conditions not materially less favorable, taken as a whole, than those set forth in the Debt Commitment Letter
amend, modify, supplement, restate, assign, substitute or replace the Debt Commitment Letter to add and appoint additional arrangers, bookrunners, underwriters, agents, lenders and similar entities
permanent take-out financing incurred in lieu of the bridge facility contemplated under the Debt Commitment Letter
the parties acting as lead arrangers or agents for, and prospective lenders of, the Debt Financing

Parent shall have notified the Company that it is commencing the Marketing Period on a date certain (in accordance with clause (A)(ii) of the definition thereof) in connection with the each such attempt to access the financing markets, in which case a Marketing Period shall be deemed to commence on such date specified for such attempt

Parent will reimburse the Company for any documented and reasonable out-of-pocket costs and expenses (including attorneys’ fees) incurred by the Company Group in connection with the cooperation of the Company Group contemplated by this Section (c)

The Company Group and their respective Representatives will be indemnified and held harmless by Parent from and against any and all liabilities, losses, damages, claims, costs, expenses (including attorneys’ fees), interest, awards, judgments, penalties and amounts paid in settlement suffered or incurred by them in connection with their cooperation in arranging the Financing
giving due regard to local market practice in connection with the repayment in full and termination of commitments of a debt facility in the applicable jurisdiction

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKETING_PERIOD: Parent's satisfaction of debt-financing funding conditions and its compliance with financing-agreement obligations are to be timed with regard to the Closing and completion of the Marketing Period.

attributes.why_unmapped: ALTERNATIVE_FINANCING: If the Debt Financing becomes unavailable or the Debt Commitment Letter or Definitive Debt Financing Agreements are withdrawn, repudiated, terminated or rescinded, Parent must arrange substitute debt or preferred-equity financing sufficient (together with remaining available Financing and cash on hand) to pay the Required Amount on the Closing Date, on terms not materially less favorable than the original Debt Commitment Letter.
